name: React Best Practices
description: Change React components, data flow, and rendering using the patterns already in the project.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the component and its data source.
Find the project's existing component and data patterns.
Change the component that owns the bug or behavior.
Run component tests when the project has them.
Read type errors in the component tree.

validation.rule: The change follows the project's existing React patterns, and run_typecheck or run_tests returned a result.
